artifacts.name: Alfa Romeo - Bluetooth Last Sync
artifacts.description: Bluetooth device last-sync times from an Alfa Romeo agenda.sqlite.

artifacts.name: Alfa Romeo - Contacts
artifacts.description: Contacts (with phone numbers and the Bluetooth address of the BT_Device row each contact links to) from an Alfa Romeo agenda.sqlite.

artifacts.name: Alfa Romeo - Sirius Settings
artifacts.description: SiriusXM (SDARS) settings/values from an Alfa Romeo sdars_db.sqlite.

artifacts.name: Berla iVe Export Record
artifacts.description: The vehicle and acquisition record an iVe .iVa export carries, with one row per acquisition giving the module, the acquisition type, the error message iVe recorded (shown as "no error reported" when the field is empty) and the counts iVe reported parsing.

artifacts.name: Bluetooth HCI Snoop - Captures
artifacts.description: Bluetooth HCI snoop captures (btsnoop files), one row per capture, with the first and last record time, the number of commands, events and other packets, and the addresses, name and version numbers the controller's answers in the capture state.

artifacts.name: BMW MGU - Connected Apple Devices
artifacts.description: Media library records from the head unit's iap2 stores (iap2_library table), with the identifier parsed from each store's file name and the device UDID each record holds.

artifacts.name: BMW MGU - Connected Device Media
artifacts.description: Media items the head unit indexed from connected Apple devices, with title, artist, album, genre and duration as the unit recorded them.

artifacts.name: BMW MGU - Request Documents
artifacts.description: One row for each request document: the position it carries, the request reason and counter, the mileage and position age bands, and the software levels it states.

artifacts.name: BMW MGU - Privacy Settings In Request Documents
artifacts.description: The data privacy settings named in the request documents, one row for each distinct setting and value, with how many documents carry it and the lowest and highest request number among them.

artifacts.name: Ford SYNC - Bluetooth Devices In Devlog
artifacts.description: Bluetooth device details from Ford SYNC devlog text logs (BT/devlog_*.txt), one row per file. Each column shows the last matching line in the file.

artifacts.name: Chrysler - Accessory Data
artifacts.description: Accessory data (name::value pairs) from a Chrysler media/accessory_data.txt.

artifacts.name: Chrysler - Bluetooth Devices
artifacts.description: Bluetooth device addresses and names read from bdAddr and name lines (repeated pairs listed once) in a Chrysler betula/bt_log.txt.

artifacts.name: Chrysler - Contacts List
artifacts.description: Voice-recognition phonebook contacts (name/information pairs) from a Chrysler voice/asr phonebook export.

artifacts.name: Chrysler - Device Manager Devices
artifacts.description: Device names and addresses (DeviceListTable) from Chrysler vehicles (DeviceManagerDeviceList bz2-compressed sqlite).

artifacts.name: Chrysler - Diagnostic Data
artifacts.description: Diagnostic key/value data from a Chrysler persistence/nonvol_*.ps log.

artifacts.name: Chrysler - GPS
artifacts.description: Latitude and longitude values from "Latitude read from PS" and "Longitude read from PS" lines in Chrysler slog files. No time is reported and a repeated pair is listed once.

artifacts.name: Chrysler - Location Logs
artifacts.description: Location records (with accuracy, speed, course and the location method each line names) parsed from Chrysler JSR179 persistent logs.

artifacts.name: Chrysler - PhoneBook Devices
artifacts.description: Phonebook BT device list with connect/disconnect times from Chrysler vehicles (PhoneBookDeviceList bz2-compressed sqlite).

artifacts.name: Connected Devices In devices.db
artifacts.description: Rows of the device_master table in a vehicle infotainment devices.db. Last Connected Time is last_connected_time read as a Unix time (unit chosen by magnitude) and shown in UTC.

artifacts.name: Contacts In contact.db
artifacts.description: Contact records (with phone, email, address and the device_id each contact is linked to; a contact with several numbers or addresses appears once per combination) from a vehicle infotainment contact.db.

artifacts.name: Hyundai - Dipo Audio UUIDs
artifacts.description: Preference entry names (with the stored value of pref_key_local_bt_address only; values of other entries are not reported) from a Hyundai Santa Fe com.daudio.app.dipo pref_dipo.xml.

artifacts.name: Ford - Device History In SmartDeviceLink Log
artifacts.description: Device appeared and disappeared lines (name, serial, uuid, device type) from a Ford smartdevicelink.log.

artifacts.name: Ford - Bluetooth Devices In devices.json
artifacts.description: Bluetooth devices (MAC, serial, name) from a Ford devices.json. An entry missing any of the three values is not listed, and a repeated entry is listed once.

artifacts.name: Ford SYNC 4 - Diagnostic Events
artifacts.description: Rows of the head unit's events_metadata table, with the creator_id of each one and the uploaded value where the record carries a date string.

artifacts.name: Ford SYNC 4 - Diagnostic Upload Errors
artifacts.description: Failures the head unit recorded while trying to upload diagnostic events, each with a timestamp and the boot count current at the time.

artifacts.name: Ford SYNC 4 - Diagnostic Identifiers
artifacts.description: Identifier values the head unit stored beside its diagnostics configuration, reported as stored.

artifacts.name: Ford - Recent and Favorite Places
artifacts.description: Places from Ford recents_storage and favorites_storage files (id, label, address, coordinates). The table does not say which of the two files a row came from. An empty label or address is shown as "None", an entry with no coordinates is not listed and a repeated entry is listed once.

artifacts.name: Ford SYNC 4 - Dead Reckoning Speed Data In Log
artifacts.description: Dead-reckoning speed/heading data from Ford fdp logs.

artifacts.name: Ford SYNC 4 - HMI Application State
artifacts.description: State the head unit's HMI applications persisted to IndexedDB, reported by application, database, object store and key with the value as stored.

artifacts.name: Ford SYNC 4 - Vehicle Capability Values
artifacts.description: One stored value for each topic in the HMI applications' MQTT_API_TOPIC_MAP database: the record with the highest LevelDB sequence number for that topic in the first application store that holds it.

artifacts.name: Ford SYNC 4 - HMI Local Storage
artifacts.description: Values the head unit's HMI applications stored in Chromium Local Storage, with the time each write batch was recorded. Superseded versions of a key are reported alongside the current one.

artifacts.name: Ford SYNC 4 - Installed Software
artifacts.description: Software packages present on the head unit, each with the package identifier, the part number, the display name, the version and the package type the unit recorded.

artifacts.name: Ford - Bluetooth Device Name
artifacts.description: The device_name value from a Ford bluetooth_v1.ddb, reported as stored. Whether it names the vehicle model is not established.

artifacts.name: Garmin Navigation App - Paired Devices
artifacts.description: Rows of the device table in the navigation application's data_manager.sqlite, with the account rows linked to each. Unexercised: the tables were empty on the one tested extraction.

artifacts.name: Garmin Navigation App - Call Log
artifacts.description: Rows of the call_log table in the navigation application's data_manager.sqlite, with the contact and device rows they link to. Unexercised: the table was empty on the one tested extraction.

artifacts.name: Garmin Navigation App - Messages
artifacts.description: Rows of the sms table in the navigation application's data_manager.sqlite, with the contact, conversation and device rows they link to. Unexercised: the table was empty on the one tested extraction.

artifacts.name: Garmin Navigation App - Contacts
artifacts.description: Rows of the contact table in the navigation application's data_manager.sqlite (unexercised: empty on the one tested extraction), with their phone numbers, email addresses and postal addresses.

artifacts.name: Garmin Navigation App - Calendar
artifacts.description: Rows of the calendar_event table in the navigation application's data_manager.sqlite, with the event_instance start and end times linked to each. Unexercised: the tables were empty on the one tested extraction.

artifacts.name: Garmin Navigation App - Trips
artifacts.description: Rows of the trips table in the navigation application's data_manager.sqlite, with their waypoints as stored. Unexercised: the table was empty on the one tested extraction.

artifacts.name: Garmin Navigation App - Search History
artifacts.description: Rows of the search_history table in the navigation application's data_manager.sqlite. Unexercised: the table was empty on the one tested extraction.

artifacts.name: Garmin Navigation App - User Settings
artifacts.description: Settings the built-in navigation application stored against a user profile, each with the value as stored and the row's time_stamp.

artifacts.name: Garmin Navigation App - Global Settings
artifacts.description: Settings the built-in navigation application stored without a user profile, each with the value as stored and the row's time_stamp.

artifacts.name: Ford - Phonebook Contacts
artifacts.description: Phonebook contacts (name + number list) from Ford vehicles (BTPhonebook).

artifacts.name: Ford SYNC 4 - Navigation Analytics Events
artifacts.description: Events from hmi.analytics lines in the head unit's fdplog.vn.txt logs, each with its phase, attributes, redacted field names and thread id.

artifacts.name: Ford SYNC 4 - Last Shutdown
artifacts.description: The shutdown the head unit recorded most recently, with the boot count, the time, the uptime for that cycle and the initiator and reason it stored.

artifacts.name: Ford SYNC 4 - Last Reset Reason
artifacts.description: The reset the head unit recorded most recently in its own reset reason file, with the boot count, the time, and the initiator and reason it stored.

artifacts.name: Ford SYNC 4 - Charge Locations In Log
artifacts.description: Charge locations named in the platform log's charge settings lines: the list the line belongs to, the location id and the latitude and longitude it carries, with the first and last time each was logged.

artifacts.name: Ford SYNC 4 - Navigation Searches In Log
artifacts.description: Navigation searches named in the platform log's analytics lines, one row per search id, with the search type and options, the number of result lines, the provider and the logged duration.

artifacts.name: Ford SYNC 4 - Positions In Log
artifacts.description: Positions in the platform log's lbs component lines, each with its log time, the kind of line it came from and the result, altitude or heading the line states.

artifacts.name: Ford SYNC 4 - Wi-Fi Access Points In Log
artifacts.description: Wi-Fi access points named in the platform log's CM component scan result lines, one row for each network name and address, with the first and last time it was logged, the number of lines, the strongest signal and the channels.

artifacts.name: Ford SYNC 4 - Vehicle Signals In Log
artifacts.description: Vehicle signal lines in the platform log: door status, gear position, odometer value, current street, ignition with driver door, tire pressures, driver distraction state and the odometer in a vehicle data notification, each with its log time and the values the line states.

artifacts.name: Ford SYNC 4 - Power Manager Events In Log
artifacts.description: Power manager lines in the platform log that name an event: ignition, engine off, door ajar and the other events the line names, CAN event lines, the ignition status and the remote start status, each with its log time and the value the line states.

artifacts.name: Ford SYNC 4 - Battery Voltage Lines In Log
artifacts.description: Battery voltage lines the power manager wrote to the platform log, each with its log time and the three numbers the line states.

artifacts.name: Ford SYNC 4 - Bluetooth Phone Status In Log
artifacts.description: Bluetooth phone status lines in the platform log: the phone status line with its seven numbers, the Bluetooth radio status event line, the connected phone notification and the number of phone devices, each with its log time.

artifacts.name: Ford SYNC 4 - SiriusXM Channel Lines In Log
artifacts.description: SiriusXM lines in the platform log that name a channel: the current channel line and the connectivity banner line with its chn# value, each with its log time.

artifacts.name: Ford SYNC 4 - Network Lines In Log
artifacts.description: Network lines in the platform log: the wlan.dcs lines that state an interface name and a MAC address, and the network up and down lines with the IP address they state, each with its log time.

artifacts.name: Ford SYNC 4 - Package Transfers In Log
artifacts.description: Packages named in three lines of the platform log's cpm component, one row per package id, with the first and last log time, the total bytes and highest percentage of its transfer progress lines, the states logged and the number of checksum verified lines.

artifacts.name: Ford SYNC 4 - Personal Profile Lines In Log
artifacts.description: Personal profile lines in the platform log, one row for each run of lines that state the same values, with the first and last log time of the run and the number of lines.

artifacts.name: Ford SYNC 4 - Reset History
artifacts.description: One row for each boot in the stability monitor's reset history: when the reset ended, when the previous shutdown was logged, the wake source text, and the reset type, initiator and reason the file states.

artifacts.name: Ford SYNC 4 - Stability Monitor Events
artifacts.description: Lines of the stability monitor's log: boot cycle starts, ignition and power level changes, suspends, shutdowns, resets and faults, each with its clock reading, seconds since boot and boot cycle.

artifacts.name: Ford SYNC 4 - Web Application Storage Use
artifacts.description: One row for each web application's storage bucket: the application folder, the use count and the last accessed and last modified times its quota database stores.

artifacts.name: Ford SYNC Gen3 - Bluetooth Phonebook
artifacts.description: Contacts in the head unit's numbered PhoneBook tables, with the names, the phone numbers the record carried, email and postal address as stored. One row per contact per table number, shown as Table Number.

artifacts.name: Ford SYNC Gen3 - Bluetooth Call History
artifacts.description: Rows of the head unit's numbered Combined tables, with the call time assembled from the stored components, the direction, and the name and number the record carried.

artifacts.name: Ford SYNC Gen3 - Bluetooth Paired Devices
artifacts.description: Rows of the head unit's PairedDevInfo table, with the name, model, manufacturer, network name, software version, Bluetooth address and subscriber number stored in each.

artifacts.name: Ford SYNC WinCE - Policy Table Snapshot Values
artifacts.description: Values the unit filled into its policy table snapshots: the module identity and exchange counters, vehicle make, model and year, usage and error counts for the module and for each application id, and the device entries with their consent records.

artifacts.name: Ford SYNC WinCE - Call History
artifacts.description: Entries of the three call lists the module keeps for each handset, with the name and number stored in each entry, its position in the list, and the call time where the entry carries one.

artifacts.name: Ford SYNC WinCE - Phonebook
artifacts.description: Contacts in the phonebook files the module keeps for each handset, with the name and the phone numbers stored for each contact.

artifacts.name: Ford SYNC WinCE - Persistent Phonebook Names
artifacts.description: Contact names in the plain-text name list the module keeps for a handset, one name a line, with the handset address from the file name.

artifacts.name: Ford SYNC WinCE - Text Messages
artifacts.description: Text message records the module stored for each handset, with the message time, the phone number, the name and the message text held in each record.

artifacts.name: Ford SYNC WinCE - Media Sources
artifacts.description: The media source the module cached in each source slot: the source's name and the identifier string stored with it, such as a USB device's serial and manufacturer or a Bluetooth handset's address.

artifacts.name: Ford SYNC WinCE - Paired Devices In Log
artifacts.description: Paired device lines from the module's debug log, one row per distinct device line per log file, with the device name, handset address, device number, primary value, pair order and how many lines repeated it.

artifacts.name: Ford SYNC WinCE - Phone Connections In Log
artifacts.description: Phone connect and disconnect lines from the module's debug log, with the device name and handset address in each line, its tick and line number, and the last log save clock reading above it.

artifacts.name: Ford SYNC WinCE - GPS Positions In Log
artifacts.description: GPS readings written into the module's message log (MsgLog), one row per line: the latitude and longitude fields as the line states them, a decimal value derived from each, and the altitude, heading, speed and satellite fields as stored.

artifacts.name: Ford SYNC WinCE - Odometer Readings In Log
artifacts.description: Odometer values the module's debug log recorded, one row per distinct value per log file, with both numbers the line carries and how many lines repeated them.

artifacts.name: Ford SYNC WinCE - Log Save Clock Readings
artifacts.description: The wall clock readings in the module's debug log: one row per 'start saving retailmsg' line, with the clock value the line states, its tick and its line number.

artifacts.name: Ford SYNC WinCE - Unit Information
artifacts.description: Identifying values the module's debug log states: the VIN in VinService lines and the software build string in Build Information lines, one row per distinct value per log file.

artifacts.name: Ford SYNC WinCE - Log Events
artifacts.description: Door, gear position, park lamp, ignition, odometer, reboot source, USB attach and phone connection lines from the module's debug log, read from the log files and from the raw partition image, each with its tick count, a clock derived from the nearest line that states a date and time, and where in the image it was found.

artifacts.name: Ford SYNC WinCE - Phone Connection Lines In Log
artifacts.description: Lines of the module's log that name a phone connection attempt, a connected HFP port or a disconnected one, in the log's own terms, read from the log files and the raw partition image, each with its tick count, a clock derived from the nearest line that states a date and time, and where in the image it was found.

artifacts.name: Ford SYNC WinCE - Paired Device Lines In Log
artifacts.description: Entries of the paired device list the module writes into its log, read from the log files and the raw partition image: one row per distinct entry, with the device name, device address, device number, the active and primary values and pair order on the line, how many times its line was found across the sources and where in the image.

artifacts.name: Ford SYNC WinCE - Device Activity Lines In Log
artifacts.description: Lines of the module's log that record a Bluetooth device being activated or deactivated, a call list file being saved for a device, and the emergency assist code logging a phone connect or disconnect status event, read from the log files and the raw partition image, each with its tick count, a derived clock and where in the image it was found.

artifacts.name: Ford SYNC WinCE - Power Lines In Log
artifacts.description: Lines of the module's log that record a power state being started and, on the tested SYNC Gen1 version 5 unit, a change in the system state the log spells out in six named fields (sysRunSt, HmiSt, SysReady, IgnSt, PwrMode and DrvDstr, as the log writes them), read from the log files and the raw partition image, each with its tick count, a derived clock and where in the image it was found.

artifacts.name: Ford SYNC WinCE - Clock Lines In Log
artifacts.description: Lines of the module's log that state a date and time, one row per line: the log save line and, on SYNC Gen2, the clock service line, read from the log files and the raw partition image, with the tick count and where in the image the line was found.

artifacts.name: Ford SYNC WinCE - Call History In Flash Image
artifacts.description: Call list entries read from the call list documents in the module's raw NAND image, with the list, name, number and call time of each entry and how many documents in the image hold it.

artifacts.name: Ford SYNC WinCE - Call History In Partition Image
artifacts.description: Call list entries read from the call list documents in an exFAT partition image of the module, with the list, name, number and call time of each entry, how many documents hold it, and whether those documents sit in a listed file, in an allocated cluster no listed file holds, or in a free cluster.

artifacts.name: Ford SYNC WinCE Gen2 - Text Messages
artifacts.description: Rows of the text message store the module keeps for each handset, with the message time, the address, name and body stored in each row and the read status as stored.

artifacts.name: Ford SYNC WinCE Gen2 - Wi-Fi Network List
artifacts.description: Rows of the module's Wi-Fi network list, with the network name, access point address, stored location text, signal strength and priority of each network.

artifacts.name: Ford SYNC WinCE Gen2 - Profile Settings
artifacts.description: Rows of the module's profile settings table, with each feature name and stored value beside the value the DefaultUser.db in the same folder holds for that feature.

artifacts.name: Ford SYNC WinCE - Registry Bluetooth Devices
artifacts.description: Bluetooth devices named in the module's registry hive, one row per device address, with the device name, pair time, phone make and model strings and connection settings stored under it.

artifacts.name: Ford SYNC WinCE - Registry Values
artifacts.description: Values read from the module's registry hive files, each with its key path, name, stored type number and data.

artifacts.name: Ford SYNC WinCE - Voice Name Cache
artifacts.description: Names in the cache the module's speech recogniser keeps for person names, each with the string stored with it, its entry number and its position in the file.

artifacts.name: Ford - VIN
artifacts.description: Vehicle Identification Number(s) from a Ford vin.txt.

artifacts.name: GM Bosch HMI - Bluetooth Devices
artifacts.description: Rows of the head unit's Bluetooth device table, with the device name and address, the paired and last connected clock readings, and the voice mail number and USB-style vendor and product identifiers the row carries.

artifacts.name: GM Bosch HMI - Phonebook Contacts
artifacts.description: Contacts in the head unit's per-device phonebook tables, with names, phone numbers, emails, postal addresses and the contact photo when the row holds one. Includes rows read from the database's freelist pages, marked in Record Source.

artifacts.name: GM Bosch HMI - Call History
artifacts.description: Call history rows from the head unit's phonebook database, with the call clock reading, the call type, and the name and number the row carried. On the six tested units the rows came from the database's freelist pages and the call tables themselves were empty.

artifacts.name: GM Bosch HMI - Media Devices
artifacts.description: Rows of the media player's device table: USB, Bluetooth audio and other media sources the unit recorded, with the last connected clock reading, the device name, identifier, serial number and connection count.

artifacts.name: GM Bosch HMI - Phone Projection Device History
artifacts.description: Rows of the smartphone-integration device history table, with the device name and manufacturer stored in each, and the category, type and support values as stored.

artifacts.name: GM Bosch HMI - Navigation Recent Destinations
artifacts.description: Rows of the navigation unit's recent destination memory, with the access clock reading as Timestamp, the destination name and address parts, and the stored coordinates.

artifacts.name: GM Bosch HMI - Navigation Address Entries
artifacts.description: Dated rows of the navigation unit's autocomplete table: address text with the access clock reading and the stored entry type.

artifacts.name: GM Bosch HMI - Added Predefined Messages
artifacts.description: Rows of the predefined text message table whose creation type differs from the value the unit's stock messages carry.

artifacts.name: GM Bosch HMI - Voice Command Recordings
artifacts.description: Audio capture files the speech interaction logger left on the unit, with the clock reading in each file name, the file size and the audio wrapped so it can be played.

artifacts.name: GM Bosch HMI - Internet Apps Device Table
artifacts.description: Rows of the internet applications database's device table: a device address with the type, last connected value and phone number stored beside it.

artifacts.name: GM Bosch HMI - Unit Information
artifacts.description: Identifiers and software versions the head unit stores: the learned VIN, the unit's Bluetooth address, software and build version strings, the Bosch part number and the last connected network name.

artifacts.name: GM GA-130 - Bluetooth Phonebook
artifacts.description: Contacts in the radio's numbered Bluetooth phonebook tables and on the database's freelist pages, with the sort name, first and last name, the phone numbers and their stored types, the postal address the row carries, and whether the row is a table row or a freelist row.

artifacts.name: GM GA-130 - Bluetooth Call History
artifacts.description: Rows of the radio's numbered received, dialled and missed call tables, with the call clock reading, the name and number the row carries, and which table it came from.

artifacts.name: GM GA-130 - Address Book
artifacts.description: Entries of the radio's numbered address book databases, with the name, the cell, home, work and other phone numbers and the postal address each entry carries.

artifacts.name: GM GA-130 - Media Stores
artifacts.description: Rows of the media engine's media store table: the phones, players and USB storage the radio registered, with the name and identifier of each and the last seen and last sync times.

artifacts.name: GM GA-130 - Played Media
artifacts.description: Tracks in the media engine's library that carry a last played time or a play count, with the title, file name, the media store they belong to and those values.

artifacts.name: GM GA-130 - Media Library Entry Times
artifacts.description: Times the media engine stamped on its library entries, grouped: one row per database file, media store and date_added second, with how many entries carry it and the earliest and latest last_sync among them.

artifacts.name: GM GA-130 - Media Name Index
artifacts.description: Song names with the artist, album and genre the index links them to, and playlist names, from the radio's numbered media name databases.

artifacts.name: GM OnStar Flash Image - GPS Track
artifacts.description: Position records found in a GM OnStar module's raw flash image, one per second, with the time, latitude, longitude, speed and heading of each record.

artifacts.name: GM OnStar Flash Image - Navigation Destinations
artifacts.description: Navigation destination lines found in a GM OnStar module's raw flash image, with the log time and the latitude and longitude each line states.

artifacts.name: GM OnStar Flash Image - Navigation Guidance Prompts
artifacts.description: Turn-by-turn guidance prompt lines found in a GM OnStar module's raw flash image, with the log time, the maneuver, the street named and the distance text of each prompt.

artifacts.name: GM OnStar LG Gen9 - Bluetooth Devices
artifacts.description: The Bluetooth device slots the telematics module stores, with the device number, name and Bluetooth address held in each occupied slot.

artifacts.name: GM OnStar LG Gen9 - Phonebook
artifacts.description: Contacts in the phonebook file the telematics module keeps for each Bluetooth device number, with the last name, first name and the home, work, mobile and other numbers stored for each contact.

artifacts.name: GM OnStar LG Gen10 - GPS Reports
artifacts.description: GPS reports the telematics module stored, with the UTC time, latitude and longitude of each report and the elevation, speed, course, dilution of precision and satellite count stored with it.

artifacts.name: GM OnStar LG - Power Off Log
artifacts.description: Power-off records the telematics module wrote, one per poweroff.log file, with the clock reading in the record and the two numbers that follow it.

artifacts.name: GM OnStar LG Gen10 - Stored Values
artifacts.description: Selected values from the generation 10 module's text state files: the redial and recall numbers, the module's own mobile numbers, destination coordinates and text, stolen-vehicle and dealer values, and the unit expiry date, each with the save time of the document it came from.

artifacts.name: GM OnStar LG Gen9 - GPS Track
artifacts.description: Position records the telematics module's navigation storage holds, one per second, with the time, latitude, longitude, speed and heading of each record.

artifacts.name: GM OnStar LG Gen9 - Navigation Destinations
artifacts.description: Destination lines from the telematics module's turn-by-turn navigation log, with the log time and the latitude and longitude the line states.

artifacts.name: GM OnStar LG Gen9 - Navigation Guidance Prompts
artifacts.description: Guidance prompt lines from the telematics module's turn-by-turn navigation log, with the log time, the maneuver, the street named and the distance text of each prompt.

artifacts.name: GM OnStar LG Gen9 - Navigation Clip Names
artifacts.description: Clip names listed in the Dyn Clips lines of the telematics module's turn-by-turn navigation log: the clip number and the text stored for it, with the line's log time and the clip's position in the line.

artifacts.name: GM OnStar LG Gen9 - Embedded Phone Stored Numbers
artifacts.description: Phone numbers held in two fixed fields of the telematics module's phone state file: one single-number field and one list of up to twenty numbers.

artifacts.name: GM OnStar LG Gen10 - Trouble Code Entries
artifacts.description: Entries of the trouble code table in a generation 10 module's dtc.dat state file, one row for each index, code, symptom and state stored together, with the earliest and latest TimeStamp of the documents that held it.

artifacts.name: GM OnStar LG - Unit Information
artifacts.description: Identifiers and versions the telematics module stores: the VIN, the device id, the assembly label code, the software version lines and the network interface address.

artifacts.name: GM OnStar LG Gen9 - Route File Destinations
artifacts.description: The address block of a downloaded route file: a position with the house number and street name stored after it.

artifacts.name: GM OnStar LG Gen9 - Route File Maneuver Points
artifacts.description: Positions with road names from a downloaded route file, in file order, with the two numbers stored between each position and its name.

artifacts.name: GNSS Receiver Files - Stored Position
artifacts.description: The position stored in the GNSS receiver's position file, with the time in the file's header.

artifacts.name: GNSS Receiver Files - File Header Times
artifacts.description: The header time of each GNSS receiver state file: almanac, ephemeris, clock, ionosphere, UTC, oscillator, position and health files.

artifacts.name: Hyundai - Call History
artifacts.description: Bluetooth call history per connected phone from Hyundai/Kia infotainment CH_{mac}.db databases.

artifacts.name: Hyundai - Bluetooth Contacts
artifacts.description: Bluetooth contacts per connected phone from Hyundai/Kia infotainment MC_{mac}.db databases.

artifacts.name: Hyundai - Bluetooth Paired Devices
artifacts.description: Bluetooth device MAC addresses and friendly names from Hyundai/Kia wireless_dev_list.dat.

artifacts.name: Hyundai - Infotainment Data
artifacts.description: Key=value lines from a Hyundai wifi/settings file. Lines containing a square bracket and lines that do not hold exactly one "=" are not reported.

artifacts.name: RAM - GPS Locations from Logs
artifacts.description: GPS locations (KONA-LIB LocationDistributor) parsed from RAM 1500 persistent logs.

artifacts.name: Ford - Media Service
artifacts.description: Rows of the mediastores table in a Ford SYNC mediaservice_db. The attached, active_onshutdown and remote columns are shown as Yes for 1, No for 0 and "Not Specified" otherwise.

artifacts.name: Nissan 08IT - Call Logs
artifacts.description: Entries of the incoming, outgoing and missed call files the head unit keeps for each handset, with the call clock reading, the phone number and, on generation 8000, the name stored in each entry.

artifacts.name: Nissan 08IT - Handset Phonebook
artifacts.description: Entries of the phonebook file the head unit keeps for each handset, with the name and the phone numbers stored in each entry.

artifacts.name: Nissan 08IT - Bluetooth Device Table
artifacts.description: Slots of the head unit's Bluetooth device table, with the handset address stored in each occupied slot and, on generation 8000, the device name.

artifacts.name: Nissan 08IT - GPS Track
artifacts.description: Position records from the head unit's compressed location logs, one per second while a log was being written, with the time, latitude and longitude of each record.

artifacts.name: Nissan 08IT - GPS Log Summary
artifacts.description: One row per compressed location log, with the time and position of its first and last position record and the number of position records it holds.

artifacts.name: Nissan 08IT - Media File List
artifacts.description: File names in the fixed-record media file lists the unit keeps under its USBA, USBV and DATACD folders, with each name's position and the number stored after it.

artifacts.name: Nissan 08IT - Music Library Tracks
artifacts.description: Track records of the unit's music library file: the title, the path of the audio file on the hard disk, a stored date and time and a second stored date with the number that follows it.

artifacts.name: Nissan 08IT - Music Library Albums
artifacts.description: Album records of the unit's music library file: the album name, a stored date and time and the count the record stores.

artifacts.name: Nissan 08IT - Disc Title Records
artifacts.description: Disc records of the unit's title store: the album, album artist and year stored for a disc and the title and artist stored for each of its tracks.

artifacts.name: Nissan 08IT - Navigation Backup Records
artifacts.description: Named records of the unit's navigation backup files: the text stored in each record, which on the tested unit read as place names and street addresses, the date the record carries, and three numeric fields of the record, shown as stored, whose meaning is not established.

artifacts.name: Nuance VCA - Devices

artifacts.name: Nuance VCA - Handset Phonebook
artifacts.description: Contacts in the voice-control phonebook database kept for each handset, with the first name, last name, email, phone number and the number type text the database stores.

artifacts.name: Nuance VCA - Media Library Entries
artifacts.description: Track, artist, album and playlist names in the voice-control media databases kept for each media source, with the source number from the file name.

artifacts.name: Nuance VCA - Media Source Info
artifacts.description: The info row of a voice-control media database: the media source's name, identifier, manufacturer, firmware and the item counts stored for it.

artifacts.name: Nuance VCA - Contacts
artifacts.description: Contacts with phone numbers from a Nuance VCA phone database (NuanceVCAdb/Phone*.sqlite).

artifacts.name: QNX Media Sync - Media Stores
artifacts.description: One row for each media sync database: the store type and mount path, the device identifier it carries, when it was last synced, the first and last time a file was added and the number of files and playlists.

artifacts.description: Files in each media sync database with the artist, album and genre its metadata links to, the year and track number, and the time the file was added to the database.

artifacts.description: Playlists in each media sync database with the name, the number of entries and the modified time the database stores.

artifacts.description: Rows of the policy database's device table: the stored device identifier with the hardware, operating system, version and carrier text recorded for it.

artifacts.name: SDL Policy - Application Usage
artifacts.description: Rows of the policy database's application usage table: the application id, the nicknames and types the policy lists for it, and the minutes and counts the component tallied.

artifacts.name: SDL Policy - Consent Records
artifacts.description: Consent records of the policy database: the functional group, the consent value and input, the application and device identifiers and the stored time stamp.

artifacts.name: SDL Policy - Module Values
artifacts.description: The values the policy database holds about the module itself: identity and exchange counters, vehicle make, model and year, and the module's usage and error counts.

artifacts.description: Times stored in the single-value files lastRebootTimeKey, lastOnlineTimeKey and lastHeartbeatTime in the head unit's persistence volume; what each time marks is taken from the file name only.

artifacts.name: SiriusXM App - Account and Device
artifacts.description: Values of eight single-value files (lastUserLoggedIn, lastAvailableUsername, LastEpisodeDownloadUser, DeviceIdKey, ClientDeviceIdKey, vehicle_info_metric_id, appRegion, freeToAir) in the head unit's persistence volume.

artifacts.name: SiriusXM App - Recently Played
artifacts.description: Entries of the SiriusXM application's recently played lists, with the start and end times each entry stores, its play, content and asset types and the channel it names.

artifacts.name: SiriusXM App - Favorites
artifacts.description: Entries of the SiriusXM application's favorites lists, with the asset name, type, channel id and short description each entry stores.

artifacts.name: SiriusXM App - Listener Profiles
artifacts.description: The listener profiles in the SiriusXM application's vehicle profile file, with the first login and switch login times each stores and its name, username and phone fields.

artifacts.name: SiriusXM App - Satellite Listening History
artifacts.description: The SATRfyListeningHistory document of the SiriusXM application: its lastTunedTime and its sidList.

artifacts.name: SiriusXM App - Account Record
artifacts.description: The values that are not empty in the SiriusXM application's non_pii_information file, one row per key, with the key's path in the document.

artifacts.name: System Manager Log - Events

artifacts.name: System Manager Log - CPU Sample Sessions
artifacts.description: One row for each block of CPU usage samples in the usage log, with the boot count the block is headed by, the clock readings of its first and last sample and the number of samples.
